d:
Today we arrived at Ghatshila's most mysterious place—Siddheshwar Pahari!
The steep, 658-meter trek led us straight to an ancient Shiva Temple. Talking to the priest, we learned that this temple is linked to the exile of the Pandavas, who established Mahadev here.
In this vlog, you will learn:
The path and difficulty of climbing the hill (Rocky Trek).
Is this really a Mica hill? Which mineral did we find on the way!
The truth about the registration process and fee (Only ₹30 per group)!
Temple Darshan timings (Timings: 8 AM to 5 PM).
